svg.title: Red White, 1961 — interpretive SVG study
svg.desc: Organic red/white contours approximated from the museum-supplied photograph; rectangular canvas retains its white painted field.
svg.metadata: Primary record: https://www.si.edu/object/red-white%3Ahmsg_72.161; visual reference: https://www.smithsonianmag.com/arts-culture/why-ellsworth-kelly-was-giant-world-american-art-180957652/; reviewed 2026-10-27; hand-authored interpretive study, not a facsimile; approximate geometry and standardized screen colours.
